name: Pumpkin Spice Pancakes with Maple Syrup

instructions.primary_message: Place flour, sugar, baking powder, baking soda, pumpkin spice mix, and salt in a large bowl. Whisk to combine the dry ingredients and set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 cups all-purpose flour
3 tbsp brown sugar
2 tsp baking powder
1 tsp baking soda
2 tsp pumpkin spice mix
¼ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Place milk, pumpkin, egg, vinegar, and vanilla in a medium bowl. Whisk to combine.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ cups whole milk
½ (425 g) can pure pumpkin purée
1 egg
2 tbsp apple cider vinegar
½ tsp vanilla extract

instructions.primary_message: Place butter in a large skillet and melt over medium heat. Remove from heat and add to the bowl with the milk mixture, whisking quickly to combine the wet ingredients. (Reserve skillet for later use.)
Create a well in the center of the dry ingredients. Add wet ingredients to the bowl and gently stir until batter is just combined.
Return skillet to medium-high heat. Add more butter and swirl to coat the bottom.

Working in batches (adding more butter as necessary), use a ¼-cup measure to drop batter into the skillet, spacing scoops a few inches apart. Cook, flipping once, until pancakes are golden and cooked through, 2-3 minutes. Remove to a plate.
To serve, divide pancakes between plates; top with butter and drizzle with maple syrup. Enjoy!
instructions.secondary_message:
butter, unsalted
⅓ cup pure maple syrup
